description: DynamicTrees JSON file to define a soil and its properties

primitive_soil.description: The block the soil is made of. It will turn back into it when the tree is removed

acceptable_soils.description: The list of soil categories that this rooty soil belongs to. (not block tags)

type.description: Allows for custom behavior beyond these properties. The options are {water, spreadable}. More can be added by addons

substitute_soil.description: Another soil properties, when a tree is planted on this primitive soil the block will turn into its substitute soil instead, and this one will not have its own rooty block. Example: farmland turns to rooty dirt when a tree is planted on it, so there is no rooty farmland block.

block_registry_name.description: The registry name of the block (By default it uses "rooty_" + the name of the file)

required_light.description: Minimum light for the soil to to be spread on

spreadable_soils.description: The acceptable blocks the soil can spread from
